## Safety checklist

- [ ] Missing public data is never labeled guaranteed available.
- [ ] Provider requests remain documented, read-only, and rate conscious.
- [ ] No secret, private endpoint, scraping, or protection bypass was added.
- [ ] Validation and provider output remain server-side where required.
